description:
Fully renovated 1+1 bedroom apartment for lease near Donlands TTC subway station on Line 2 (Bloor-Danforth). This unit has a private separate entrance, 1 private parking space included, and ensuite laundry with an in-unit washer and dryer. Snow removal and lawn care are also included, so there is no outdoor maintenance for the tenant. Inside, the open concept layout puts the living room, dining area and kitchen in one bright, well-lit space with modern finishes throughout, and the kitchen has stainless steel appliances. The den works as a home office, guest room, nursery or extra storage, which suits anyone working from home, and the unit has its own private outdoor space. The apartment is steps to Danforth Avenue in the Danforth East York neighbourhood of Toronto's east end, minutes from Greektown, with grocery stores, cafes, restaurants, banks, pharmacies and parks within walking distance. It is a short walk to Donlands subway station for a direct ride to Yonge-Bloor and downtown Toronto, with quick access to the Don Valley Parkway (DVP). A good fit for a professional, couple or remote worker looking for a private 1 bedroom plus den rental with parking in a transit-friendly area. (id:24493)
